mapper.sql:
FROM public.orders trades JOIN public.clients clients ON clients.client_id = trades.client_id LEFT JOIN public.instruments instruments ON instruments.instrument_id = trades.instrument_id LEFT JOIN public.instrument_type types ON types.instrumenttype_id = instruments.instrumenttype_id WHERE trades.status = 2 AND clients.is_admin IS NOT TRUE AND clients.is_analyst IS NOT TRUE AND trades.time_purchased >= #{start} AND trades.time_purchased <= #{end}
AND trades.client_id IN #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(trades.trade_type)) IN ('BUY', 'SELL') THEN UPPER(TRIM(trades.trade_type)) ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS direction, COALESCE(types.instrumenttype, 'Other') AS instrument_type, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COALESCE(SUM(trades.quantity * trades.purchase_price), 0) AS trade_volume
GROUP BY CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(trades.trade_type)) IN ('BUY', 'SELL') THEN UPPER(TRIM(trades.trade_type)) ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, types.instrumenttype

SELECT trades.time_purchased AS activity_time, COALESCE(types.instrumenttype, 'Other') AS instrument_type, COALESCE(SUM(trades.quantity * trades.purchase_price), 0) AS trade_volume
GROUP BY trades.time_purchased, types.instrumenttype ORDER BY trades.time_purchased

SELECT instruments.symbol, instruments.symbol_name, COALESCE(types.instrumenttype, 'Other') AS instrument_type, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COALESCE(SUM(trades.quantity * trades.purchase_price), 0) AS trade_volume
GROUP BY instruments.symbol, instruments.symbol_name, types.instrumenttype ORDER BY total_trades DESC, trade_volume DESC

SELECT client_id AS id, username, email FROM clients WHERE is_admin IS NOT TRUE AND is_analyst IS NOT TRUE AND (LOWER(username) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(email) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))) ORDER BY username LIMIT 20
